'''Crystalline Wolves''' are mid-level monsters found in the [[Gauntlet]]. Their counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] is the [[Corrupted Wolf]]. Mid-level monsters always spawn in pairs, if they spawn in a room.
